fields.summary_ko.0: Berkshire Hathaway (BRKA, BRKB) currently holds $18.6 billion invested in Chevron (CVX), representing 4.3% of Chevron shares and 5% of Berkshire's portfolio, its sixth-largest stock investment.
fields.summary_ko.1: Chevron stock has risen more than 40% over the past 12 months, with projected compound annual earnings growth of 5% and EPS growth of 26% for 2025-2028, and a forward dividend yield of 3.2% suggests strong potential for Dividend Aristocrat status.
